subject: Witchcraft
body:
Belladonna! That's how it always starts.

There's real witchcraft in this world, and it begins with an oven. Cook a Rowan Sapling in a Witches Oven with a Jar beside it, and see what the Jar catches. Here's how it all goes together. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:witchery_oven @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/oven I'll add pages to the book as you go.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
